title: Pod OOMKilled due to undersized memory limits
symptoms: Pod status OOMKilled with exit code 137
Intermittent 502/503 from service during pod restarts
Datadog memory utilization at 100% before kill
root_cause: Memory limits set below actual working set; no VPA recommendations applied; memory leak in application (less common)
workaround: Temporarily increase memory limit via kubectl patch or Helm values override; scale replicas to distribute load
permanent_fix: Deploy VPA in recommendation mode; right-size limits based on P99 usage + 20% headroom; add memory leak detection in APM; update Helm chart defaults

auto_healing.mechanism: VPA auto mode (with approval gate) or Karpenter node provisioning for memory-constrained scheduling

notes: Correlate with namespace-level resource quota reviews
